title: Bucket outside source
reproduction: Create transparent 8×8 raster; Paint Bucket red at document (-1,1), or outside a translated layer.
reference: Observed baseline regression and engine/document preservation invariants. No Adobe capture claim.

title: Mask clips downscaled source
reproduction: Place 32×32 opaque raster into 8×8 document with .25 scale; add Reveal All mask. Repeat with 16×16 at .5 scale and document selection (4,2)→(8,8).
expected: Reveal All preserves all 64 visible pixels; selection mask covers exactly selected document pixels.
reference: Observed baseline regression and engine/document preservation invariants. No Adobe capture claim.

title: Nested alignment changes group geometry
reproduction: Group two 10×10 children at x=10 and x=40; select group plus right child; align left in 100×100 document.
expected: Child positions become x=0 and x=30; spacing is retained.
reference: Observed baseline regression and engine/document preservation invariants. No Adobe capture claim.

title: Native parser accepts corrupt editable state
reproduction: Serialize 8×8 native document; separately delete transform x/paths, substitute object guides, select unknown ID, or inject malformed adjustment/effect/filter. Open.
expected: Each malformed document is rejected before acceptance with an Invalid data error.
reference: Observed baseline regression and engine/document preservation invariants. No Adobe capture claim.

title: Copy truncates soft selection edges
reproduction: Copy opaque 3×1 raster through coverage [64,255,64]; also copy [0,64,0].
expected: Copy preserves width 3 and alpha [64,255,64]; low-coverage-only selection remains copyable.
reference: Observed baseline regression and engine/document preservation invariants. No Adobe capture claim.

title: Deleted mask leaves incorrect paint target
reproduction: Create transparent raster and mask; select mask, delete mask, paint red at (3,3), undo painting, undo deletion.
expected: Paint targets pixels and writes [255,0,0,255]; undo restores source transparency and selected mask.
reference: Observed baseline regression and engine/document preservation invariants. No Adobe capture claim.
